notes.title: New lower price - 50% off!
notes.notes:
As of May 2018 Trench Run has a much lower price to reflect that it is mainly a 4-PLAYER local couch multiplayer game (with optional bots play and online game support). Unfortunately since release in 2016 the game never gained enough momentum to sustain a large multiplayer community. 

We still believe that it is a fantastic game to play locally with friends or with bots. It is easy to pick up and fun to play on gamepads. The price is low and in return for buying it you'll spend a hilarious couple of evenings blasting your friends. Enjoy!

notes.title: Trench Run Build 16 Released!
notes.notes:
A round of most important fixes.

Changes:
- lobby bug fixes
- sniper bot a bit less perfect
- map fixes
- wrong series-end conditions in cases of many ties

*we are aware of the "singleplayer crashes after playing multiplayer" bug, it will be fixed as soon as we find a solution*

notes.title: Trench Run Build 15 Released!
notes.notes:
Mandatory after-launch patch with some good bug fixes and quality of life improvements :).
Also lets celebrate the Steam launch with a  -50% sale on the in-game items.
Have fun!
And invite friends!

[img=https://thd.vg/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/crocball_confusing.gif] [/img]

Changes:

[added] lobby players in other games in scoreboard
[modified] a bit quicker team briefing in Run
[modified] improved medic bot AI
[modified] bots arent so afraid of remote bomb
[added] slightly better steam auth error handling
[removed] unranked servers button (temporarily)
[modifed] blinking healing icon
[modified] lobby music plays infinitely until someone makes it stop

PS. Please e-mail support@thd.vg if you bought TR earlier and you want a Steam key.
